newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Theta-led group buys S.Africa Alternative Finance.
newsitem.headline: Theta-led group buys S.Africa Alternative Finance.

text.p: An investment consortium led by Theta Securities has acquired Alternative Finance Ltd from South Africa's Independent Development Trust (IDT) in a 175 million rand deal, the two parties said on Thursday.
The deal would be with effect from March 1.
The consortium comprises Alternative Finance (Altfin) management and staff, Baobab Solid Growth, Litho Investments and Theta Capital Investments.
Momentum Life, The National Housing Finance Corp, life assurers Old Mutual and Sanlam and Southern Life's Futuregrowth have invested 103 million rand in the capital structure of Altfin.
Altfin is one of South Africa's specialises in the provision of small, unsecured, short-term loans to individuals who are unable to raise loans in the formal banking sector.
"The transaction completed Altfin's conversion from a wholesale to a retail financier, bringing it into the mainstream of South Africa's financial markets.

"We will now focus exclusively on the needs of our individual clients. We have empowered thousands of clients as most of the borrowing is used for basic home improvements or education," said Altfin managing director Franz Pretorius.
Theta Securities managing director Leon Kirkinis said that IBCA's long-term A- rating for paper issued by Altfin will enhance its ability to raise funds in the capital market.
Combined with focused marketing, risk management and systems development, this will precipitate accelerated growth, he said.
